summary: Frontend-only testing (static portfolio, no backend). Executed Playwright tests at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All critical selectors, flows, 3D interactions, counters, dataset switching, autorotate toggle, bar-click readout updates, nav + mobile menu + smooth scroll, hero CTAs, email/LinkedIn links, copy-to-clipboard toast, and back-to-top worked end-to-end with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: data.js placeholder content: companies/metrics in Experience and projects impact numbers (4+, 20+, $12M, 50+) are fabricated. Confirm with user before publishing a real portfolio.
Hero mix-blend-difference custom cursor is hidden on mobile (correct) but overrides pointer-events in a 100svh section; cursor:none can be jarring on touchpad desktops - minor UX nit.
HeroScene/StudioScene are lazy-loaded with no explicit Suspense fallback on hero - a brief flash occurs before WebGL mounts. Consider a subtle placeholder.
Studio canvas uses data-lenis-prevent correctly; good. OrbitControls scroll-to-zoom may fight Lenis on trackpad - current implementation handles it correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 feature items from the review request were verified green on desktop + mobile. No console errors. 3D interactions (bar-click to update readout, dataset switch, autorotate toggle) work. All data-testid attributes exist and are stable. If re-testing, no need to retest 3D clicks via mouse coordinates - was flaky across multiple attempts but succeeded; prefer programmatic state verification instead.
